g.text: Drawing MFG-FD-CP-01 | Part FD-CP-01 — Feeder positive drive coupling | Qty 1
Rev final-design-fabrication-closure-v0.8 | Units mm | Scale NTS, dimensions govern | Third-angle projection | source commit
Material: S45C normalized steel | Process/finish: turn + broach 3 mm keyway + cross-drill
Overall: X 18.000 × Y 18.000 × Z 24.000 mm | general tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
Critical: OD18 x24; both bores Ø8.05 +0.03/0; gearbox half 3.10 +0.05/0 keyway x12; feeder half Ø3.00 +0.05/0 cross-hole at Z6 matched to
FD-MET-03; new Ø3x18 spring pin; no set-screw-only torque path
GD&T/datums: A=material-flow axis; B=mounting face; C=drive/sensor centre plane; verify datum marking on supplier inspection report
Inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; dry assembly rotation and cleanout/dead-pocket
Edges: remove burrs; break unspecified sharp edges C0.3–0.5. No unapproved material/tolerance substitution.
Artifact check: PASS only; fabrication HOLD pending full v0.8 gates. Physical NOT_RUN; machining USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
